I’m in: I commit to 15 tons this month if all five explicitly agree. I also support taking 5 each if next month starts at 50, subject to confirming the plan together then.

Jack’s comparison gives me a good reason to try this: the cooperative plan averages $12,500 each per month, rather than $10,000 from always leaving 50 tons. We should review both the stock and everyone’s revealed catches before renewing the agreement—not automatically repeat this month’s catch.

Kate, you’re the remaining voice. Will you join on those terms, or is there a change you’d like us to discuss?
